title: Development strategy
summary: Priorities: education quality, research, digitalisation and international partnership.

body.text: The development strategy aims to strengthen the university’s position in maritime education and research, modernise infrastructure and expand international cooperation.

items: Improving degree programmes and practical training.
Developing research schools and applied projects.
Digital transformation of learning and administration.

body.text: Progress is reviewed annually by the academic council.
